value.rationale: An exact infinite-parameter solution to a natural uniform multiplicity-two and ternary-radix variant of the recent modular-uniqueness problem. It determines the precise least modulus including parity-driven cutoff and constructs rivals for every smaller modulus, thereby going beyond numerical exploration and textbook substitution.
